$comment: Blueprint 727 E4.10 — the declared destructive-operation policy for every MCP plugin, one entry per tracked plugins/mcp/* directory. Lives BESIDE the plugin dirs (never inside) so .source.json mirrors stay untouched. policy ∈ {refuse, recommend-only, permit-with-confirmation, permit}: refuse = no destructive tool surface exists (backed by a pinned-surface refusal test); recommend-only = destructive ops surfaced but refused by an enforcing artifact (backed by an executable refusal test); permit-with-confirmation = code requires explicit opt-in/approval before destructive ops; permit = destructive ops run when called (honest, no gate — the rationale names the blast radius). Enforced by scripts/check-mcp-destructive-policy.mjs (doc-governance, blocking): entry required per tracked dir, artifact paths must exist, refuse/recommend-only declarations must name a refusal test that the gate EXECUTES and requires to pass. Classification sweep: 2026-08-19 (AAR 000-docs/800).

a2a-client.rationale: cancel_task can stop work on a remote A2A agent. Enforcement is three-layered: cancellation defaults off unless the operator sets A2A_ALLOW_TASK_CANCELLATION=1, the MCP server then requires confirmation exactly equal to 'cancel <taskId>', and hooks/hooks.json forces a host-side PreToolUse approval prompt for direct and plugin-namespaced cancel_task invocations. Blast radius is the named task on the caller-selected remote agent.

ai-experiment-logger.rationale: delete_experiment and update_experiment run immediately on call with no confirmation. Blast radius: the plugin's own ~/.ai-experiment-logger/experiments.json store.

conversational-api-debugger.rationale: Read/analyze-only surface (load_openapi, ingest_logs, explain_failure, make_repro); make_repro builds a command string but never executes or writes.

databricks-workspace-mcp.rationale: Read-only workspace surface (list/get/events); no create/edit/delete/terminate endpoint is reachable from any registered tool.

design-to-code.rationale: Generates code as a returned string; no file writes, no network.

dolt-mcp-vcs.rationale: Destructive verbs (push/pull/both merges/reset --hard/branch-delete/DROP DATABASE) are refused at the MCP wire by the guard proxy (E4.9); safe-write SQL requires DOLT_MCP_ALLOW_MUTATION=1. Mirror content — the guard lives upstream (dolt-mcp-vcs-plugin#10).

domain-memory-agent.rationale: delete_document runs on call with no gate. Blast radius: a process-local in-memory Map — nothing persisted is destroyed.

governed-second-brain.rationale: No delete/purge tool exists; writes are append-only and audited; the only lifecycle mutation is a validated, reason-required, hash-chain-anchored state transition. Mirror content — declaration lives here, not in the mirror.

lumera-agent-memory.rationale: Upload-only surface (content-addressed, additive); no delete tool is wired to MCP; live egress is env-gated and defaults to mock.

pr-to-spec.rationale: set_intent unconditionally overwrites one fixed plugin-owned file (<repoPath>/.pr-to-spec/intent.yaml; directory overridable via PR_TO_SPEC_DIR); GitHub access is read-only (pulls.get, listFiles, listReviews, listReviewComments). Mirror content — declaration lives here, not in the mirror.

project-health-auditor.rationale: Read-only metrics surface; git access is log/show only.

servicegraph.rationale: unlock_rows irreversibly spends paid credits (~$0.10/row) against the remote HTTP server (mcp.servicegraph.co) — no local code path exists in the server itself, so enforcement is a host-side PreToolUse hook (curated hardening, 2026-08-19): the hook returns permissionDecision 'ask' on every unlock_rows call, turning the SKILL.md cost-confirmation instruction from prose into an enforced prompt for hosts honoring hook decisions. Read-only tools are unmatched. Residual: a host that ignores hook decisions gets the raw remote surface.

slack-channel.rationale: Mutations pass an authored policy engine (auto_approve/deny/require_approval with deny-by-omission); destructive admin verbs additionally require an out-of-band single-use HMAC nonce handshake (nonce-hitl.ts). Mirror content — declaration lives here, not in the mirror.

workflow-orchestrator.rationale: execute_workflow is a simulated stub — no child_process, fs write, or network. The refusal test pins the absence of real execution so wiring child_process later fails the gate instead of silently becoming permit.

x-bug-triage.rationale: No tool performs a real external write: confirm_and_file is a synthetic-URL stub behind a draft→duplicate-check→confirm chain; the retention purge is reachable only from scripts/cleanup.sh, not from any MCP tool. Mirror content — declaration lives here, not in the mirror.
